'''Marina Fernández Muelas''' (born 11 May 1996) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a midfielder for Andorran-based Spanish Women's First Division of Catalonia club ENFAF and the [[Andorra women's national football team|Andorra women's national team]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Primer amistós davant Malta|url=http://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/54888/primer-amistos-davant-malta|publisher=Esports|accessdate=26 April 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Futbol femení amb Marina Fernández|url=http://www.andorradifusio.ad/Programes/becaris/becaris-24-de-juny-de-2016/futbol-femeni-amb-marina-fernandez|publisher=AndorraDifusio|accessdate=26 April 2017}}</ref>
